facts.fact: 中文：维罗妮卡把藏在身后的礼物递给尼克，并让他闭眼伸手。
facts.anchor: Veronica commanded, snapping the heels of her Louboutins together smartly and handing Nick a package she was hiding behind her back.

facts.fact: 中文：尼克拆开包装，取出一件深灰色羊毛手工V领突击队毛衣。
facts.anchor: he separated the tissue paper inside and pulled out a handmade v-neck commando sweater in dark-grey wool

facts.fact: 中文：维罗妮卡说毛衣是她亲手织的，祝尼克生日快乐。
facts.anchor: “I knitted it for you,” said Veronica. “Happy Birthday, my honey.”

facts.fact: 中文：维罗妮卡说她赶在尼克出发前织完了，加德满都会非常冷。
facts.anchor: “I’m glad I got it finished in time for your trip,” Veronica said. “It’s going to be fucking cold in Kathmandu.”

facts.fact: 中文：尼克说每次监视探测路线前约一小时会把手机放进法拉第袋。
facts.anchor: I’ll be popping it into a Faraday bag an hour or so before each Surveillance Detection Route

facts.fact: 中文：维罗妮卡说前方作战基地的自杀式炸弹袭击改变了一切。
facts.anchor: the suicide bombing at Forward Operating Base ███████ changed everything

facts.fact: 中文：尼克说他已订好两人谈过的那家餐厅，等他回来就去。
facts.anchor: I made that reservation we talked about, for when I get back.

facts.fact: 中文：两人做完晚餐——烤鸡配红土豆、炒菠菜和面包——在烛光下并排吃。
facts.anchor: They finished making dinner, a roasted chicken with red potatoes, sautéed spinach, and bread, which they ate by candlelight
